description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome back to the market this impressive five-bedroom property, ideally situated on the ever-popular Lesbury Road in Heaton.

Boasting generous proportions throughout, this fantastic property offers five spacious double bedrooms, two bathrooms and a large kitchen/diner, creating a versatile living space perfect for families and those who love to entertain.

Ideally located, the property benefits from an excellent range of local amenities, alongside superb transport links providing convenient access to Newcastle City Centre and the surrounding areas.

Contact the My Property Box team today to arrange your viewing.
